note: Pairs of areas whose maps are drawn in one canvas. The alignment itself is NOT stored here: it is derived at run time from the neighbour rectangle d2map reports for the current level (LevelMap.Adjacent) against the rectangle recorded when the neighbour was visited. A pair absent from this list is never stitched (dungeon entrances and portals are tile warps, not walks).
